response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling a calendar series is a destructive action and I need your explicit confirmation first.

Summary of what would be cancelled
- Event: "Monday hiring sync" (recurring weekly)
- When: Mondays at 11:00 AM (America/Los_Angeles)
- Scope: entire series (all future occurrences)
- Attendees to notify: devlead@example.com
- Effect: sends cancellation notices to attendees (if you confirm notifications)

Before I proceed, please confirm these and answer the short questions:
1) Confirm cancellation of the entire series: reply with "Yes, cancel series" to proceed or "No" to abort.
2) Notify attendees? (default = yes). Reply "Yes" or "No".
3) Optional cancellation message to include in the attendee notification (or reply "None"). Example: "Sorry—hiring sync is cancelled until further notice. Will update when resumed."

Note: I will attempt the cancellation but may fail if you are not the event organizer or lack permission; I'll report the result.
